verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye sutvā dhammaṁ dhārenti;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who remember the teachings they hear are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye sutvā dhammaṁ na dhārenti.
verses.english: while those who don’t remember the teachings are many.
